about_the_game:
Overview

A roguelite card game where you run a ramen stall in a cyberpunk city.

You are a former hitman. You've escaped the crime family and now run a humble ramen stand.

To convince the assassin sent to bring you back—your old partner—you must serve her a bowl so perfect that it leaves no room for doubt.

Earn money to upgrade your skills and toppings, and serve even more powerful bowls of ramen.
An immersive yet casual strategic card game experience.

Gameplay

A simple game about plating toppings on your ramen.

Each run alternates between serving ramen at your stall and preparing for the next day, aiming to create the ultimate bowl.

Each topping card carries effects tied to three attributes: Trendy, Filling and Refined.

By combining them with coroutines (skills) you install, you can serve even more exquisite bowls of ramen.

By serving customers, swapping toppings, and upgrading your coroutines, you’ll create the ultimate bowl.

↑He’s N3CO-3, a cat-shaped support AI and the owner of a ramen franchise.
Sharp-eyed and business-savvy, he’s a highly capable manager.

If you fail to satisfy the gourmet customer who appears at the end of each stage, your run ends immediately.
Survive all ten days of operation to complete the run.

Story

You are a former hitman. You've escaped the crime family and now run a humble ramen stand.

To convince the assassin sent to bring you back—your old partner—you must serve her a bowl so perfect that it leaves no room for doubt.

↑She’s Yura — your partner from long before the Family.

And like you, she’s a lethal assassin. Now she’s here to bring you back.

In a cyberpunk city, no street is complete without a ramen stand.

In this dangerous, neon-lit world, rise to the top through ramen.

Features

  • Different play experiences each run through random generation

  • Simple yet strategic gameplay

  • An art style that harmonizes with the game’s system and atmosphere

Over 20 types of cards and skills offer distinct playstyles.

For example, you might run a stall that specializes in ramen piled high with icecream, or one that bets everything on premium char siu—enjoy a wide variety of unique builds.
